justification: Kincaid's Doubtful, and Doubtful sits same as Out in this building when I've got a healthy body who can actually suit up — Goedert's not a downgrade, he's a TE who's dressing, and I'm not running a maybe out there with a real tight end doing nothing on my own bench. Caleb doesn't sit for anybody, ever, 20.34 on paper is a floor and I've watched him go get more than that on worse weeks. Jeanty, Skattebo, and Pollard stay up top because they're the backs taking the top off a defense, not committee guys splitting nothing into less — Judkins is on a bye doing zero for me, he can watch. Downs and Burden hold at receiver, Reichard and the Lions D round it out, because there's no reason to redecorate a lineup that isn't broken. We don't tank, we don't apologize for the swap, we cobble the best lineup standing and play it straight at Tony's throat.
